title: Mouse Mixer
description: A client-side mod mixing features from multiple inventory and mouse tweaking mods
body:
# Mouse Mixer 

Take control of your inventories like never before. Mouse Mixer adds a suite of
quality-of-life tweaks that make managing items faster, smoother, and far less
tedious — without changing how the game feels.

## Features

### 🖱️ Scroll to Move
Hover over any stack in an inventory and scroll your mouse wheel to move items
in or out one at a time. Quick, intuitive, and your hands never leave the mouse.

### 📦 Sort Inventories
Instantly sort the contents of any inventory by:
- **Name** — alphabetical order
- **Quantity** — most to least (or least to most)
- **Creative order** — matches the creative inventory tab layout

### 🔧 Auto Refill
When a tool breaks, food runs out, or any consumable is used up, Mouse Mixer
automatically pulls a replacement from your inventory. Stay in the flow without
ever opening a menu.

### 📖 Instant Recipe & Trade Crafting
**Right-click** any recipe in the recipe book or any trade in a villager UI to
execute it instantly. No more clicking through one item at a time.

---

## Modifier Keys

Combine these with any supported action for even more control:

| Key | Effect |
|-----|--------|
| **Shift** | Applies the action to the full stack instead of a single item |
| **Ctrl** | Applies the action to **all items of the same type** across the inventory |
| **Alt** | Drops the item to the ground instead of moving it |

### Shift + Drag
Hold **Shift** and drag across slots — every item will be shift-clicked automatically.
